mapper.select: SELECT enabled, frequency_days FROM feedback_settings WHERE id = 1
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM feedback_requests WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND created_at > #{since})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feedback_requests (id, customer_id, branch_id, visit_at, due_at, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{customerId}, #{branchId}, #{visitAt}, #{dueAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.branch_id, b.name AS branch_name, r.visit_at FROM feedback_requests r JOIN branches b ON b.id = r.branch_id WHERE r.customer_id = #{customerId} AND r.sent_at IS NOT NULL AND r.expires_at > #{now} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM feedback f WHERE f.request_id = r.id) ORDER BY r.visit_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT f.id, f.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, c.phone_enc, f.branch_id, b.name AS branch_name, f.rating, f.reasons, f.comment, f.created_at, f.resolved_at, f.resolution_note FROM feedback f JOIN customers c ON c.id = f.customer_id JOIN branches b ON b.id = f.branch_id
ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE feedback SET resolved_at = #{now}, resolved_by = #{staffId}, resolution_note = #{note} WHERE id = #{id} AND resolved_at IS NULL
